name: Hash-Table Voxelization (SYCL)
definition: A SYCL implementation of the NVIDIA BEVFusion PointPillars lidar voxelization operator, using a hash-table for open addressing, scatter for point feature storage, and reduce_mean for voxel aggregation, operating in half precision with XYZ or ZYX coordinate ordering.
summary: Hash-Table Voxelization (SYCL) is a SYCL-based lidar voxelization method for Intel Arc GPUs that uses a hash table to efficiently map sparse 3D points to voxels, avoiding memory overflow in high-resolution settings.
